_comment: [20.8] COMMONWEALTH MANDATORY WITHDRAWALS -- the [4.43a] WD column (rule 20.8), transcribed from scratchpad/port/transcriptions/20.8-cw-withdrawals.md (scan pp.114-115; the docs/rules/90 OCR of [4.43a] is scrambled and NOT trusted). At the scheduled Game-Turn the named Commonwealth formation is pulled from the desert for Greece/Crete/Syria/etc. and REMOVED from play (20.84). The RETURNS (the schedule's own Rtn rows) are ALREADY seeded in reinforcements_campaign.json as fresh (Rtn) arrivals -- so this file seeds only the REMOVALS, whose absence let the CW army balloon with duplicate returned formations. GT is the Reinforcement-Track GT index (the same arrival_turn axis the reinforcement data uses), NOT a calendar date.
_wiring: engine._commonwealth_withdrawals matches each row's `match` prefixes against the on-map, alive Commonwealth counters at the withdrawal Game-Turn: a counter matches prefix P if it equals P / 'HQ '+P, or starts with P+' ' / 'HQ '+P+' ' (so 'HQ 7 In Bde', '7 In Bde I..III' and the later '7 In Bde (Rtn) I' all match 'match:[7 In Bde]', and on-map-at-turn selects the right instance across a formation's withdraw/return shuffle). `by_type` (only GT97) is the 20.82 count of additional infantry battalions chosen by TOE. `tpt` is the 20.83 transport/motorization escort the book prints [truck, motorization] -- recorded, not yet charged (the abstract economy models the removal, not the escort haul).
_coverage: Rows with match:[] are UNRESOLVED against the CURRENT (incomplete) Commonwealth OOB -- the named formation is not yet seeded (port-plan T1-2, ~175 CW counters await scan pp.114-116) -- and are transcribed here so the schedule is complete and the mechanic grows as the OOB does. 23 of the 33 rows resolve today.
_base_hexes_note: The two cities a withdrawing unit must reach (20.83/20.84 Cairo and Alexandria) are NOT enumerated here. They are read from the ONE canonical multi-hex enumeration -- data/victory_cities.json 'auto_win' (the rule-64.71 auto-win objective, and the 25.12 Level-3 forts), the same source game.scenario.delta_hexes reads -- via game.replacements.withdrawal_base_hexes. Cairo is FIVE hexes and Alexandria TWO; a private single-hex copy here (Cairo [46,140] / Alexandria [27,133]) narrowed each city to one hex and wrongly ELIMINATED (20.83) a unit standing in any of the other four/one. Removed 2026-07-24 (Block 7.2b repair) rather than duplicate-and-narrow canonical geography.

toe_threshold_errata_20_82._comment: NAMED ERRATA KEY (the 54.17 demolition class -- never applied silently). OWNER RULING 3 (Eve, PHASE-7-OWNER-RULINGS.md): rule 20.83 cites '(20.75)' for the required TOE Strength of a unit being withdrawn; 20.75 is Commonwealth Production, unrelated. The >=75%-of-maximum-TOE rule is 20.82 (and 20.85 cites 20.82 correctly). PDF p.032.
toe_threshold_errata_20_82.ruling: 20.83's '(20.75)' is a PRINTED TYPO for (20.82). A scheduled unit that by its withdrawal Stage is not at Cairo or Alexandria, OR is below 75% of its maximum TOE Strength, is ELIMINATED (20.83) rather than cleanly withdrawn. 20.82's 75% floor also governs which units satisfy a by-type withdrawal.
